Kai (People Ops): Hey all 11 quick follow-up to today's all-hands re: remote/hybrid ops 1 offsites, travel, workspace policy, and a couple edge cases we didn't finish. Post short Qs and we'll answer live. I'll add to the Workstyle FAQ. https://intranet.redwood/workstyle :loudspeaker:

Rina Bose: Question: Can I work from abroad for a month after the offsite? What about tax implications / payroll?

Kai (People Ops): Short answer: "work-from-abroad" for <=30 days is OK with manager sign-off; >30 days needs country approval (tax/legal). Start by filling the WFA pre-check form in the playbook. We coordinate with Finance & Legal for payroll and tax flags. :globe_with_meridians:

Tom Nguyen: If I do WFA during an offsite month, do I still get hub credits / coworking days covered?

Kai (People Ops): If WFA happens in the same city as a regional hub, hub-credit applies per the usual caps. If you're abroad in a non-covered country, request exception and we'll consider a one-time remote coworking stipend. Tag expenses `wf abroad-stipend` and attach location proof.

Elisa Park: Family question 1 I'm bringing my toddler to the offsite week. Any childcare or family travel support? Also, are family-friendly hotel rooms covered?

Kai (People Ops): We normally don't cover personal family travel. For exceptional childcare needs (no local daycare) we can approve a childcare stipend with manager sign-off 1 request ahead of booking. Family-friendly rooms: we reimburse the room cost within city-tier caps; upgrades for family-size or safety needs can be pre-approved under `family-exception`. DM me with dates & reason. :baby_chick:

Rina Bose: Related: are there per-diem adjustments if I'm ordering in-room meals for my kid?

Kai (People Ops): We reimburse reasonable meal costs within per-diem. For special dietary or family needs, note `family-meal` on expense and include short note. Finance will review.

FinanceBot: Notice: New per-diem multipliers for family accommodations effective 2026-02-01. See: https://intranet.redwood/policies/per-diem (automated).

Tom Nguyen: Emergency loan? If I need to rebook because of a family emergency, any short-term assistance for upfront costs?

Kai (People Ops): Yes 1 we offer an Emergency Travel Advance (up to $2k) for compassionate cases. Process: DM people-ops with manager confirmation; we route to Payroll for a one-time advance and set simple repayment terms. Tag repayments `travel-advance`.

Elisa Park: Can teams request pet-friendly lodging for a small offsite subgroup? My dog is an emotional support animal and needs to travel with me. What's required?

Maya (Legal): For documented ESA or medical needs, we treat it as an accommodation. Provide documentation via the Access form and People Ops will coordinate pet-friendly lodging and handle any incremental cost approvals. For general pet travel (non-medical), costs are personal unless manager approves as a business necessity.

Rina Bose: If the offsite location requires special permits for large shared houses, who signs the contract? Can People Ops handle rentals >8 pax?

Kai (People Ops): People Ops coordinates vendor contracting for houses >8 people. Legal reviews contracts >$10k or with unusual liability terms. Submit the offsite request form with dates, headcount, and venue link and we'll start procurement.

Tom Nguyen: Quick coding tip for Concur notes I can copy/paste?

Kai (People Ops): Sure, paste this into the expense notes:

```
Expense title: ATL-Offsite-FamRoom
Amount: 820.00
Category: Lodging - Offsite
Receipts: hotel_family.pdf
Tag: family-exception
Notes: toddler present, childcare stipend requested separately
```

Elisa Park: Any guidance on splitting shared housing costs across teams (who files expenses)?

Kai (People Ops): For shared houses we prefer one lead submitter for the booking and internal chargebacks via the team's cost center. Put co-occupant list in the notes. If you want People Ops to manage split billing centrally, request it when you submit the form.

Maya (Legal): Small legal note: if offsite activities include off-site vendor demos or client visits, please notify Legal 10 business days prior. We'll advise on NDAs and liability coverage.

Rina Bose: Thanks! Last Q 1 can the company reimburse Internet top-ups for remote attendance during the offsite? (e.g., buy a local SIM / portable Wi-Fi)

Kai (People Ops): Yes 1 short-term connectivity purchases required for work are reimbursable up to $100/day with receipts, tag `connectivity-offsite`. For longer WFA stays we handle monthly allowances case-by-case.

Kai (People Ops): I'll pin this thread and add the answers to the Workstyle FAQ. If you need fast help with a visa letter, emergency advance, or accommodation, DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com. :spiral_note_pad:
